preconditions.description: Both input strings have lengths between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in str1) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in str2)
preconditions.description: Both strings consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(str1[i] == result[j] for i, j in enumerate(range(len(result))) if result[j] == str1[i]) and all(str2[i] == result[j] for i, j in enumerate(range(len(result))) if result[j] == str2[i])
postconditions.description: The returned string `result` contains `str1` and `str2` as subsequences.

postconditions.expression: len(result) == min(len(s) for s in possible_supersequences(str1, str2))
postconditions.description: The returned string `result` is the shortest possible string that contains both `str1` and `str2` as subsequences.
